bag.constraints: BAG values are limited to powers of 2, and if a partition needs to transmit data less often than 128 ms, the BAG value 128 will be used.

ethernet.multicast_bit_rule: The least significant bit of the first byte indicates the group address (always = 1).

ip_header.header_validation: A datagram whose version number is not 4 MUST be silently discarded.
ip_header.ttl_rules: The specification does not clearly define TTL rules for AFDX.

payload.vl_specific_ranges: The specification text provided does not clearly define 'frame_structure.payload.vl_specific_ranges'.

udp_header.port_rules: Transport layer port assignments are not critical and can be assigned by a system integrator using any values in the range 1 to 65535.

monitoring.fault_detection: The specification does not clearly define 'monitoring.fault_detection'.

redundancy.accept_first_policy: When redundancy management is active, it should deliver the first of the redundant frames received.
redundancy.discard_duplicate_policy: The Redundancy Management Algorithm should only use the RSN of a frame as the criterion for rejection or acceptance.
redundancy.dual_transmission_required: The correct value is not clearly defined

sequence_numbers.handling_rules: The frame sequence number should be one octet long with a range of 0 to 255. For each VL, the sequence number should initially be set to 0. The sequence number is always assigned this initial value following a reset of the transmitting ES. The frame sequence number should be incremented by one for each consecutive frame of the same VL and wrap-around to 1 following the value 255.
sequence_numbers.missing_frame_detection: Increment by one makes it possible to detect missing frames
sequence_numbers.out_of_window_action: The specification text does not clearly define the action for out-of-window sequence numbers.

switching.forwarding_rules: The switch forwards frames filtered by the Filtering and Policing function to the appropriate physical output ports.

static_forwarding.port_mapping_rules: The specification does not clearly define the port mapping rules based on the provided text.

buffer_management.buffer_size_rules: The specification does not clearly define the buffer size rule for output ports of the switch.
buffer_management.overflow_policy: If a buffer overflow occurs in reception, an error message should be sent to the receiving partition and the frame should be discarded.
buffer_management.queue_limits: The specification does not clearly define buffer_management.queue_limits

filtering_policing.bag_enforcement: The specification does not clearly define the resolution or tolerance for traffic policing.
filtering_policing.drop_conditions: The specification text provided does not contain sufficient information to determine the correct interpretation for 'filtering_policing.drop_conditions'.
filtering_policing.policing_algorithm: Traffic policing should be based on parameters: BAG, Jitter, Smax, and eventually Smin.

token_bucket.refill_rate_formula: The specification does not clearly define the refill rate formula

frame_aging.aging_rules: The correct interpretation cannot be determined
frame_aging.max_age: The specification does not clearly define 'frame_aging.max_age'.

priority_qos.queue_separation: The Switch should have a traffic prioritization mechanism with 2 traffic classes
priority_qos.scheduling_algorithm: The specification does not clearly define the scheduling algorithm

configuration_parameters: Each Virtual Link has a dedicated maximum bandwidth
Maximum allowed Total Ethernet Line size (Smax)
Minimum allowed Total Ethernet Line size (Smin)
The system integrator is free to configure each Virtual Link with or without redundancy
integrity checking can be disabled per VL
